别名

  • 淫虐女子監獄

あらすじ

2020 AD. Population has bursted increasing crime level. Prisons are functioning at 180% capacity. Government issues Article 59 called “Prison Private Property Law”, according to which prison personnel can take prisoners home to take care of them. Main character is a part of this experiment giving shelter to five women prisoners.

item.title: Shizumanai Tsuki
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: VEGA
  • 発売日: 2001-09-14
  • スコア: 5.9399999999999995/10 (8 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 沈マナイ月
  • 英語名: Shizumanai Tsuki

别名

  • The Moon Never Sets

あらすじ

It all started with a brutal rape case somewhere in Tokyo. The chaotic rapists traumatize Akira and Satsuki. The rapists call themselves “the Moon Phase,” and are led by Mitsuru, who’s obsessed with hurting people. Akira and Satsuki are victimized in simple “playing around.”

They don’t realize that this incident will change their lives forever. The player can experience this story from a total of eight different points of view. A new character choice will be available every time the player clears the story with one character. By playing the eight different characters, the player can collect missing pieces of the puzzle to solve this erotic, yet, suspenseful event!
